capabilities: Design tables, columns, memos and relationships on a canvas
Import SQL DDL, GraphQL SDL, DBML and AML files
Export DDL for eight databases, ORM code, PNG and SVG
Maintain naming dictionaries with CSV import and export
Let coding agents edit diagrams through an MCP server
extras: Desktop only; the plugin makes no network requests and sends no telemetry, and the MCP connection is local through a socket file or named pipe. Step-by-step feature documentation lives in an external Editing Guide and MCP README. The same editor is also offered as a web app, Google Drive app, VS Code extension, IntelliJ plugin and custom element.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to design a database schema or keep an entity-relationship diagram next to the notes that describe it.
